description: I’m taking my campaign directly to you with my For a Better Maine Tour – walking from Fort Kent to Kittery to meet Mainers in their hometowns. Walk with us from Medway to Millinocket! When: Friday, August 21; 11:00 am – 6:00 pm Where: Medway to Millinocket  More details to be re
title: For a Better Maine: Medway to Millinocket — Rick Bennett for Governor
